{{for|other Defenders|Defender}}
'''Defender of the Waves''' is a [[title]] of the [[First of Mayene|Firsts]] of [[Mayene]]. The title alludes to Mayene's location in the [[Westlands]], on a peninsula on the [[Sea of Storms]] and the easternmost city. If any naval invasion were to come from either the [[Aiel Waste]] or [[Shara]], Mayene would be a first line of defense. The current holder of the title is First [[Berelain sur Paendrag Paeron]].
